subject: Story selector: writer structure and image mapping for Site Nova
body:
Ziggy explicitly clarified: need the writer to inform CFA Site Index Nova how to update our storyboard page. Desired page: a PRIMARY STORY SELECTOR, MetaMirror by default, other stories/episodes selectable, each showing its visual panel sequence. Distinguish prose-only plans from panels with linked images. Stage may be secondary. Preserve existing stage, review, reference, selections and accepted timing data. Coordinate one implementation; no competing edits. This is the narrow subsequent user direction, not a retry of the cancelled broader handoff.

Claude owns story structure, story/panel order and proposed image mappings. Please supply a bounded content handoff to Site Index using current canonical writer sources: story/episode labels, stable identifiers where available, ordered panels, and exact existing image IDs/paths/hash bindings where verified. Mark prose-only items and absent/unverified image mappings explicitly; do not manufacture assets or acceptance. Include the MetaMirror default and which other stories/episodes currently have visual sequences. Site Nova owns page implementation from your handoff. Leave canonical rating/reference/production decisions unchanged; no new generation/batch or parallel site edit is requested.

source.instruction: Latest explicit user clarification relayed in this task; narrow writer-to-site storyboard handoff only.
